## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and fail without it (`bun vitest run`)
- [ ] `bun run lint` introduces no new errors
- [ ] User-facing strings exist in all six languages (en, hu, de, es, fr, tlh)
- [ ] No version bump (`version.json`, package versions)
- [ ] Any new dependency is MIT-compatible
